attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's other venerated rows already carry, and the entry is the same four: Anthousa of Seleucia in Syria, daughter of the rich idolaters Antoninus and Martyria (Maria), who was baptised and tonsured by the bishop Athanasius at Tarsus in Cilicia, and her two servants Charisimus and Neophytus, who went with her and were beheaded. **The page's reign does not agree with the dates these folders carry.** It says «Η Οσία Ανθούσα έζησε στα χρόνια του βασιλιά Ουαλεριανού (253-259)», in the years of Valerian, 253 to 259, where the corpus has c. 298 for Anthousa and 270–275 for the other three; no `dates` object is proposed here, the page's reign and its figure of twenty-three years in the desert are recorded in the paragraph as the page's own, and the disagreement is left in the reader's report. The page also gives the mother's name two ways, «της Μαρτυρίας (Μαρίας)». No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no hymn, only three distichs — one for Anthousa, one for Athanasius and one for the two servants together.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 04.09.2026 (22. август ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Антуса, и прочи с њом.“
